item.name: show_passage

event.text: When a field gets “hot,” many teams race to publish the most striking positive results, while negative results may get less attention. With many teams testing the same questions, a chance finding is more likely to turn up and be reported; Ioannidis calls the resulting swings between bold claims and opposite refutations the “Proteus phenomenon.”
